about.label: OUR STORY
about.title: THE LCC
about.description: Founded in 2017, LCC has shaped the future of Lebanese cycling. Our culture of discipline, training, and commitment has produced multiple national champions and a strong roster of elite athletes.
about.descriptionLong: From mountain trails to coastal roads, our members push boundaries and challenge limits every day. With multiple Lebanese Championship titles and Lebanon Cup victories, we continue to inspire the next generation of cyclists in Lebanon and beyond.
